name: p4-phi
description: The memo on the session tree. Every session is a node under the session that started it; every turn's exit is kept as a play, scored or not, and handed whole to the parent; a new session starts from the goals, notes and plays above and beside it; a session holds one goal and ships a message that steers off it to a forked child. Kept in <project>/.claude/p4/phi/. Nothing is matched by its words.
